definitions.explanation: The assignment of actors to roles in a play, film, or other performance. Also refers to the resulting list of actors and their roles.

examples.japanese: {配役|はいやく}が{決|き}まった。
{監督|かんとく}が{配役|はいやく}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
この{映画|えいが}は{配役|はいやく}がぴったりで、{全員|ぜんいん}の{演技|えんぎ}が{素晴|すば}らしかった。
examples.english: The casting in this film was perfect, and every actor's performance was wonderful.

notes:
USAGE:
{配役|はいやく} can refer to both the process of casting (assigning roles) and the result (the cast list). In modern usage, the loanword キャスティング (casting) is also common for the process, while {配役|はいやく} is preferred in more formal or traditional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配役|はいやく}を{決|き}める (to decide the casting)
- {配役|はいやく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する (to announce the cast)
- {配役|はいやく}が{豪華|ごうか}だ (the cast is star-studded)
- {主役|しゅやく}の{配役|はいやく} (casting of the lead role)

RELATED WORDS:
- キャスティング (casting — loanword, more modern)
- キャスト (cast — loanword)
- {役柄|やくがら} (type of role; character)
